entry.author: Fire and Emergency NZ
entry.summary:
You can't just light a fire anywhere and anytime you want. Always check the fire season status and fire danger level, and follow the rules. Including -

• If you’re considering lighting a fire, jump on checkitsalright.nz to check whether it’s allowed and safe to light a fire 
• Use designated fire pits wherever possible and never leave a fire unattended 
• Once finished, ensure your fire is fully put out. Soak it in water and make sure no embers remain. 

Always check the local fire danger at checkitsalright.nz
